spellbook.finance/limitations: Only active cases appear. Explicit dispatch resolves a case and removes its task from the active list while preserving its timeline.
currentPreparation is the saved destination and preparation receipt. Print or dispatch using that preparationId; a newer preparation makes the older one stale.

Work rows omit the full candidate list for historical mixed-order cases. Those rows have no externalOrderId, stage inspection_required and a blockedReason; spellbook_returned_package_case keeps all original candidate identities and contents.
Work rows omit card contents. Open the original order or call spellbook_returned_package_lookup when you need the contents.
The read returns no carrier scans, postage purchase, or proof that a package was mailed.
Workspace owner role is backend-enforced. This reads only the workspace you name.

description: List active returned-order tasks in a seller workspace. Each task includes an exact externalOrderId when one order is identified, plus original destination evidence, return reason, case version and current saved preparation including the corrected destination. Historical mixed-order cases stay visible as blocked inspection tasks without selecting a candidate. Use this after spellbook_returned_package_record or after reconnecting to resume the same task. The read does not change shipment, inventory, refund, postage or marketplace state.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor returned by a prior read. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum active return tasks to return, up to 50. Defaults to 20.

marketplace.description: Limit tasks to one marketplace. Omit for all.

q.description: Find an original order by order id, label, buyer, card name, pull-session id or tracking number. Requires at least two characters.

workspaceId.description: The seller workspace from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_returned_package_work
